seoTitle: Flaccy — FLAC Player & Music Library for iPhone
metaDescription: A beautiful player for the music you own. Import FLAC, ALAC, AAC, or MP3 and get a fast library with gapless playback, synced lyrics, Last.fm scrobbling, and a standalone Apple Watch app — no streaming subscription, no account.
heroHeadline: A beautiful home for the music you own
heroSubhead: Drop in your FLAC, ALAC, AAC, or MP3 files and Flaccy turns them into a fast, gorgeous library — gapless playback, synced lyrics, Last.fm scrobbling, and a standalone Apple Watch app. No streaming subscription, no upload, no account.
highlights: Import via USB or the Files app — messy folders are identified and cleaned up automatically
Gapless playback that honors your albums, with a queue that survives relaunches
Every play scrobbled to Last.fm — even offline, with automatic retry
An honest Listening Guide: what actually reaches your ears, no snake oil

features.title: Your Library, Organized
features.body: Albums, artists, songs, and playlists with search, sorting, and stunning artwork. Scene releases and messy folder names are identified and cleaned up automatically on import.

features.title: Gapless, As Intended
features.body: Albums play the way they were mastered — no gaps, no hiccups between tracks. Your queue persists across launches, so the music picks up exactly where you left it.

features.title: Made for Listening
features.body: Synced lyrics with tap-to-seek, a Now Playing screen with ambient artwork backdrops, AirPlay, a sleep timer, and full playback controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

features.title: Scrobble Everything
features.body: Sign in with Last.fm and every play is scrobbled — even offline, with automatic retry. Loved tracks, listening charts, and artist bios matched to your library.

features.title: Year in Music
features.body: Your listening year as shareable story cards and a poster — top artists, albums, and the numbers behind them, rendered beautifully from your own plays.

features.title: Honest About Audio
features.body: The built-in Listening Guide explains what actually reaches your ears — Bluetooth codecs, why lossless can't reach AirPods, and when FLAC is worth it. No snake oil.

features.title: Phone-free on Apple Watch
features.body: Sync albums to your watch and play them offline — gapless, shuffle, repeat — no iPhone in your pocket.

features.title: See what you're playing
features.body: Codec, bit depth, and sample rate on every track — honesty down to the file.

howItWorks.body: Copy music over USB or pick files in the Files app. Flaccy identifies and cleans up messy folder names and scene releases automatically.
Browse albums, artists, songs, and playlists, then play gaplessly with synced lyrics, ambient artwork, AirPlay, and full playback controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
Sign in with Last.fm once and every play is scrobbled — even offline. Watch your charts grow and unwrap your Year in Music.

faq.q: What audio formats does Flaccy play?
faq.a: FLAC, ALAC, AAC, M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF, and CAF — with gapless playback across all of them.

faq.q: Do I need a streaming subscription or an account?
faq.a: No. Flaccy plays files you already own, stored on your iPhone. There is no upload, no account, and no subscription required. A Last.fm account is optional, only for scrobbling.

faq.q: How do I get my music into Flaccy?
faq.a: Two ways: copy files over USB from a computer, or import them through the Files app. Messy folder names and scene releases are identified and cleaned up automatically.

Yes. Sign in with your Last.fm account and every play is scrobbled — even when you're offline, with automatic retry once you're back online. You also get loved tracks, listening charts, and artist bios matched to your library.

faq.q: Is there an Apple Watch app?
faq.a: Yes — a true standalone player. Sync albums from your iPhone, then play them offline from your wrist with gapless playback, shuffle, repeat, and AirPods controls. No iPhone required.

faq.q: Is lossless audio worth it on iPhone?
faq.a: It depends on how you listen — and Flaccy is honest about it. The built-in Listening Guide explains Bluetooth codecs, why lossless can't reach AirPods, when FLAC is genuinely worth it, and what blind tests really show.

ctaLine: Your music deserves a better player.
pricingNote: Free on the App Store. No subscription, no account, no upload.
